tools_helpful.evidence: session-log.txt L2943-2978: the validator reported '[FAIL] App crashed at startup', captured pid/exit, and printed 'Fix pattern: Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 -Anchor startup-crashes' — correctly routing the agent to the crash-diagnosis anchor.
session-log.txt L2997-3040: surfaced MoAppCrash with P8=802b000a, the native XAML-parse exception code that identified the crash class.

tool_limitations.limitation: The table (0x80004003 / 0x8001010E / 0xE0434352 / 0xC000027B) did not list 0x802B000A (E_XAMLPARSEFAILED), the very code the crash tooling surfaced.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add a 0x802B000A row mapping it to missing StaticResource/ThemeResource keys (SDK-sample shared styles) with the App.xaml fix.

special_apis.special_handling: Compiles and works under WinUI 3 desktop (no adaptation needed for the NFC transfer path); it triggered SEQUENTIAL per-file edit mode because the API-name family trips the model output-safety filter.

errors_encountered.root_cause: MainPage.xaml and Scenario1.xaml reference shared sample styles ({StaticResource SampleHeaderTextStyle}, {StaticResource ScenarioDescriptionTextStyle}, etc.) that in the UWP sample came from StandardStyles.xaml / the sample-template App.xaml. Those dictionaries were not migrated into the WinUI 3 scaffold, so the references resolve at build time but throw when XAML is parsed at launch.
errors_encountered.fix: Defined SampleHeaderTextStyle / ScenarioDescriptionTextStyle in App.xaml Application.Resources (session-log.txt L3206-3211) and removed unresolved template chrome; app then launched.

errors_encountered.error: Build errors CS8803 / CS0106 (top-level statements; 'private' modifier not valid) in Scenario1.xaml.cs
errors_encountered.root_cause: A SEQUENTIAL edit on the ProximityDevice file misplaced a closing brace, dropping several methods outside the class body.
errors_encountered.fix: Corrected the class braces on the following edit; build recovered.

errors_encountered.error: XamlCompiler WMC0909 'Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario' + WMC1111 in MainPage.xaml
errors_encountered.root_cause: DataTemplate x:DataType/x:Bind against the sample's Scenario class while other build errors kept the project from a clean compile; resolved once the type compiled and MainPage was rebuilt.
errors_encountered.fix: Rebuild after fixing the class-structure and resource errors.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: App built clean but died within 10s at launch; native code 0x802B000A.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: ~10 turns: read WER, decoded the HRESULT, then bisected by hand-simplifying MainPage.xaml and moving styles into App.xaml.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Missing shared-style resource dictionaries (StandardStyles.xaml / sample App.xaml) not migrated; the startup-crash table had no 0x802B000A entry to name the cause.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Manually simplified MainPage.xaml and defined the referenced styles in App.xaml Application.Resources.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A 0x802B000A row in the startup-crash native-code table plus a 'migrate/define referenced non-system resource keys' pattern — both now added to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md.

missing_tooling.need: A pre-build check that lists every {StaticResource}/{ThemeResource} key the migrated XAML references and flags any not defined in the project and not a WinUI 3 system key.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The ~10-turn manual bisection of the 0x802B000A launch crash.
